lines.text: U-gv-wi-yu-hi-no da-ka-ne-tsi hi-a ni-do-da-ga-we-se-li; U-do-hi-yu-hi-ya hi-a ni-tsv-we-se-ha, Na-s-gi-ye-no tsi-ne-tsa-dv-ne-lv u-s-di-ka-ni hi-a na-s-gi o-tsa-li-nv-tli, a-yv ni-s-gi-ya-dv-ne-lv-gi.
lines.english: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.
lines.emitted_text: ukvwiyuhinho takhanetsi hi'a nitotakawehseli ii utohiyuya hi'a nitsvwahseha v nvhskiyheno' tsinetsatvnhelv uhstikhanhi yanvhski utsalhinvtli i ayanihski yatvnhelvki

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᏉ ᏂᏙᏓᎦᏪᏎᎵ ᎠᎦᏍᎦᏂ ᎢᏗᏢ ᎠᏂᏙᎾᎢ; ᏍᎩᏯᏓᏅᏏ, ᎡᏥᏍᎦᏨᎯ, ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᏥᎸᏱ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏫᏥᎶᎯ, ᎾᏍᎩ ᎠᏍᎩᎾ ᎠᎴ ᏧᏤᎵ ᏗᏂᎧᎿᎭᏩᏗᏙᎯ ᎨᎪᏢᎾᏁᎸᎯ.
lines.text: Hi-a-no na-s-quo ni-do-da-ga-we-se-li a-ga-s-ga-ni i-di-tlv a-ni-do-na-i; S-gi-ya-da-nv-si, e-tsi-s-ga-tsv-hi, wi-na-s-dv-na a-tsi-lv-yi di-ge-sv wi-tsi-lo-hi, na-s-gi a-s-gi-na a-le tsu-tse-li di-ni-ka-hna-wa-di-do-hi ge-go-tlv-na-ne-lv-hi.
lines.english: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:
lines.emitted_text: hiy'anhonahskwu nitotakawehseli akhskani'i ititla anitona'i hskiyatvnvhsi enihskatsvhi a wunahsthvna atsilvyi tikelhv witsilohi v nvhski'ahskina ale tsutseli'i i v tinikanhvwati'tohi kolhvnanelvhi

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎠᎪᏄᏰᏃ ᎠᎩᏲᏏᏍᎬᎩ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏱᏍᎩᏰᎳᏍᏔᏁᎢ; ᎠᎩᏔᏕᎩᏍᎬᎩ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏱᏍᎩᎤᏁᎢ;
lines.text: A-go-nu-ye-no a-gi-yo-si-s-gv-gi, v-tla-no yi-s-gi-ye-la-s-ta-ne-i; a-gi-ta-de-gi-s-gv-gi, v-tla-no yi-s-gi-u-ne-i;
lines.english: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:
lines.emitted_text: akoniyhenho akiyohsihskvki v vlha yihskiyelahsthane'i' akhtsatekihskvki vlha ihskiy'une'i

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᏅᎩᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏱᏍᎩᏴᏔᏁᎢ; ᎠᎩᏰᎸᎭ ᎨᏒᎩ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏱᏗᏍᎩᏄᏬᎡᎢ; ᎠᎩᏢᎬᎩ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎥᎩᏍᏚᎲᎩ, ᎥᏝᏃ ᏱᏍᎩᏩᏛᎯᎴᎢ.
lines.text: Nv-gi-ga-ta-hv-na ge-sv-gi, v-tla-no yi-s-gi-yv-ta-ne-i; a-gi-ye-lv-ha ge-sv-gi, v-tla-no yi-di-s-gi-nu-wo-e-i; a-gi-tlv-gv-gi, a-le di-da-s-du-di-yi v-gi-s-du-hv-gi, v-tla-no yi-s-gi-wa-dv-hi-le-i.
lines.english: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.
lines.emitted_text: nvki khthahvna v kehsvki vlhayihskiyvthane'i akiyelvha kehshvki v vlha yitihskinawo'e'i i akhtlvkvki' ale titahstutiye vkhstuhvki v ulhv yihskiwahthvhilhe'i

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎾᏍᏉᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏛᏂᏁᏥ, ᎯᎠ ᏅᏓᎬᏩᏪᏎᎵ, ᏣᎬᏫᏳᎯ, ᎢᎳᎩᏳ ᎢᏨᎪᎡ ᏣᏲᏏᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏔᏕᎩᏍᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏁᏣᎦᏔᎲᎾ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏰᎸᎭ ᎨᏎᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏣᏢᎨᎢ, ᎠᎴ ᏗᏓᏍᏚᏗᏱ ᎡᏣᏍᏚᎮᎢ, ᏂᏨᏍᏕᎸᎲᎾᏃ ᎨᏎᎢ?
lines.text: Na-s-quo-no na-s-gi dv-ni-ne-tsi, hi-a nv-da-gv-wa-we-se-li, Tsa-gv-wi-yu-hi, i-la-gi-yu i-tsv-go-e tsa-yo-si-s-ge-i, a-le tsa-ta-de-gi-s-ge-i, a-le ne-tsa-ga-ta-hv-na ge-se-i, a-le tsa-ye-lv-ha ge-se-i, a-le tsa-tlv-ge-i, a-le di-da-s-du-di-yi e-tsa-s-du-he-i, ni-tsv-s-de-lv-hv-na-no ge-se-i?
lines.english: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?
lines.emitted_text: nahskwunho nvhskitvninhetsi hi'v nitakvwawehseli a tsukvwiyuhi ilakoyu utsvko'e av tsayohsihske'i v ale tsithvtekihske'i v ale netsakhthahvna akelhe'i alatsayelvha kehsv'i aletsatlvke'i ale titahstutiyi etsahstuhe'i v nityvhstelhv'nho kelhe'i

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎿᎭᏉᏃ ᏓᎧᏁᏥ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏙᏓᎦᏪᏎᎵ; ᎤᏙᎯᏳᎯᏯ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏨᏪᏎᎭ, ᎾᏍᎩᏰᏃ ᏁᏣᏛᏁᎸᎾ ᎨᏒ ᎤᏍᏗᎧᏂ ᎯᎠ ᎾᏍᎩ, ᎠᏴ ᎥᏝ ᏱᏂᏍᎩᏯᏛᏁᎴᎢ.
lines.text: Hna-quo-no da-ka-ne-tsi hi-a ni-do-da-ga-we-se-li; u-do-hi-yu-hi-ya hi-a ni-tsv-we-se-ha, na-s-gi-ye-no ne-tsa-dv-ne-lv-na ge-sv u-s-di-ka-ni hi-a na-s-gi, a-yv v-tla yi-ni-s-gi-ya-dv-ne-le-i.
lines.english: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎯᎠᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎠᎩᎵᏲᎢᏍᏗᏱ ᏗᎨᏒ ᏮᏛᏂᎶᏏ; ᎤᎾᏓᏅᏘᏍᎩᏂ ᏫᎾᏍᏛᎾ ᎬᏂᏛ ᏗᎨᏒᎢ.
lines.text: Hi-a-no na-s-gi wi-na-s-dv-na a-gi-li-yo-i-s-di-yi di-ge-sv wv-dv-ni-lo-si; u-na-da-nv-ti-s-gi-ni wi-na-s-dv-na gv-ni-dv di-ge-sv-i.
lines.english: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.
